THE MONEY-FENCE IS THIS SHIM'S TO CARRY — it has no other holder. The child ticket inference-domain-chat-verb briefly put a builder-aider row in the inference proxy's domains stack with escalation.allow ['hex'], and that row was the only thing standing between build traffic and a paid provider. Akien killed it on 2026-08-16: "The inference proxy knows about providers and models. it does not understand about consumers. the consumer asks for what it wants. period, end of story" — with the why: "if the inference proxy knows about consumers, then there is no need for domains. and then the inference proxy becomes extremely complicated." So the fence is not a provider-side allow-list; it is THE SHIM ASKING FOR EXACTLY ONE THING. Build obligation: this shim requests provider hex and model qwen3-coder:30b by name and never widens under failure — no fallback-to-anything-that-answers, because a fallback is precisely how a local-only device starts spending money. Asking narrowly IS the safety, and it must be proved by a tooth that reds when the ask widens.
